kind: Prospective protocol-only batch: one explicit ideal-equilibrium exercise and matched catalyst/no-catalyst teaching controls; three requests, two original ranks

cases.kind: explicit ideal-equilibrium exercise; not a timed Fischer experiment
cases.script:
add v1 CH3COOH 0.001mol
add v1 ethanol 0.001mol
inspect v1
react v1 esterification
inspect v1
positive_expectations: Before react, both neat reactants remain near0.001mol; no ethyl acetate/water product is assumed from waiting.
Explicit org_reacted esterification event has finite positive extent approximately0.0006666666666667mol for the implemented ideal K4 model.
Ethyl acetate and water each increase by extent; acetic acid and ethanol each decrease by the same extent; carbon/hydrogen/oxygen/charge close.
The event states ideal-mixture equilibrium and explicitly withholds catalyst, activity corrections, temperature dependence and reaction heat.
negative_expectations: No acid catalyst, timed Fischer kinetics, empirical yield or modeled reaction-heat claim is supplied.
No unrequested complete conversion; no solver_failed, safety_veto or unsupported react-command outcome.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 H2O2 0.001mol
add v1 MnO2 0.0001mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
positive_expectations: The implemented peroxide-decomposition clock advances during the explicit10second wait.
Compared with the matched no-catalyst control, more peroxide is consumed and more target oxygen is produced.
Peroxide loss equals water gain and twice generated O2; open-boundary exported gas is included once in H/O/Mn/charge closure.
MnO2 inventory remains0.0001mol rather than being consumed as a stoichiometric reagent.
negative_expectations: No catalysis calibration, measured absolute rate, complete empirical mechanism or newly fitted constant is claimed.
No missing-water-product, oxygen-from-background-air-as-target, catalyst disappearance, solver_failed or safety_veto is accepted.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 H2O2 0.001mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
positive_expectations: Same water,25C preparation, peroxide dose and10second wait as the catalyst control.
Finite background peroxide decomposition may occur; it must remain less than the catalyst control under this existing teaching law.
Any actual peroxide loss closes against water gain and generated/exported oxygen; no Mn inventory is present.
negative_expectations: No MnO2 catalyst is silently inferred or reported; no absolute zero-rate forecast is imposed.
No empirical rate agreement is assigned from a zero process exit or this matched comparison.

scope.protocol_changes: Rank17 adds implemented explicit react operation to a neat mixture. Rank32 separately declares lower peroxide dose, open gas boundary and a catalyst/no-catalyst comparison; original sealed0.002mol screen remains unchanged.
